title: ozothamnus rosmarinifolius
intro: Ozothamnus rosmarinifolius, commonly known as Rosmary-leaved White Smoke Bush, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ozothamnus rosmarinifolius are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds contributing to its medicinal value.
